name: Shadow - Between The Worlds
source:
You are dead. Or dying. Caught between existence and oblivion, you meet The Shadow—a presence that has watched your entire life. 

Not to judge you. But to show you the truth about who you were, what you believed, and why you chose to leave.

[From [url=https://yoihoi.itch.io/shadow-between-the-worlds]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经死了——抑或正在弥留之际。在存在与虚无的夹缝之间，你邂逅了“暗影”——一个注视了你整个人生的存在。

它并非为了审判你而来，而是为了向你揭示真相：你曾经究竟是谁、信奉过什么，又为何最终选择离去。

[摘自[url=https://yoihoi.itch.io/shadow-between-the-worlds]itch.io[/url]]
